claim_source_title: Sleep Deprivation Selectively Impairs Memory Consolidation for Contextual Fear Conditioning
cite_title: Effects of ocean warming and coral bleaching on aerosol emissions in the Great Barrier Reef, Australia
claim: We found that sleep deprivation from 0–5 h after training for this task impaired memory consolidation for contextual fear conditioning whereas sleep deprivation from 5–10 h after training had no effect.
text: We found that sleep deprivation from 0–5 h after training for this task impaired memory consolidation for contextual fear conditioning whereas sleep deprivation from 5–10 h after training had no effect. (DOI: 10.1038/s41598-018-32470-7)
